verdict.rationale: The Marketing API docs say RSS campaigns send according to their own schedule, which is a form of recurring, scheduled workflow. The Analytics AI page also mentions 'automations', implying automated workflows exist, but nothing describes how to configure them. Missing for 10: documented general-purpose recurring scheduling (cron-like or time-based triggers), API-level scheduling of arbitrary campaigns or workflows, automation/journey builder documentation, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
